question.text: Let $P$ be the set of all non-singular matrices of order 3 over $R$ and $Q$ be the set of all orthogonal matrices of order 3 over $R .$ Then,

options.text: Neither $P$ is proper subset of $Q$ nor $Q$ is proper subset of $P$

solution.text: All the orthogonal matrix are non-singular matrix. $\therefore Q$ is proper subset of $P$
